data.name: MapHelpBody
data.value:
Map controls
• Mouse wheel — zoom in or out. • Hold the middle mouse button and drag — move around the map. • Drag an unlocked device card with the left mouse button. • “Show all” brings all current topology devices back into view.
Positions, zoom, viewport position and locked state are saved automatically and restored on the next launch.
